insight: Never aggro creeps onto yourself during the first two waves. Wait for last hits and denies instead. Aggroing creeps causes the enemy wave to hit your creeps, pushing the lane toward the enemy.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

insight: Keep the lane static near your tower during the first wave. A static lane is safer and gives you pressure while keeping enemies in a worse position.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

matchup_context: after wave is pushed into your tower
insight: If the wave gets pushed into your tower, use repeated aggro on enemy ranged creeps away from tower range to pull the wave back. Space your aggros so the next enemy wave arrives when creeps are pulled back to your desired position.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

insight: Avoid using Area of Effect spells on the first wave as they aggro enemy creeps and push the lane toward the enemy. Heroes with natural aggro mechanics (Huskar, Drow) especially need to avoid this.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

insight: Position to the side of creep fights so you don't block ranged creep aggro. If the ranged creep only has you to attack, the lane auto-pushes regardless of creep count equality.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

insight: In winning matchups, zone the enemy without a-clicking them. This keeps the wave static while denying farm, allowing you to reach level 2 first for a kill or all-in.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

insight: Understand your level 2 kill potential before committing to early kills. If you can't kill the enemy, keep the wave static and wait for level 2 instead of pushing it.

source.title: #1 Lane Mistake To Avoid As A Carry

insight: Do not pull when the wave is already static. Pulling a static wave forces your carry to aggro creeps inside tower or lose the favored lane position.
